mapper.select: select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.source_type, d.spatial_type, d.file_format, d.original_srid, d.storage_srid, d.analysis_srid, d.is_spatial, d.is_public, d.status, c.category_name_ko, d.created_at, d.updated_at from sd_gis_dataset d inner join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and d.deleted_at is null
select count(*)::int from sd_gis_feature where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and geom_4326 is not null
select u.organization from sd_gis_dataset d inner join sd_user u on d.created_by = u.user_id where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.sql: with selected_point as ( select ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326) as geom_4326 ), simulation_features as ( select f.feature_id, f.feature_name, f.geom_4326, ST_PointOnSurface(f.geom_4326) as center_geom_4326, replace(ST_GeometryType(f.geom_4326), 'ST_', '') as geometry_type from sd_gis_feature f where f.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and f.geom_4326 is not null ), matched_raw as ( select sf.feature_id, sf.feature_name, sf.geom_4326, sf.center_geom_4326, sf.geometry_type, ST_Distance(sf.geom_4326::geography, sp.geom_4326::geography) as distance_meters from simulation_features sf cross join selected_point sp where ST_DWithin(sf.geom_4326::geography, sp.geom_4326::geography, #{radius}) ), ranked as ( select row_number() over (order by distance_meters asc, feature_id asc)::int as rank, feature_id, feature_name, geom_4326, center_geom_4326, geometry_type, round(distance_meters::numeric, 2)::double precision as distance_meters from matched_raw )
mapper.select: select #{datasetId} as dataset_id, d.title as dataset_title, #{radius} as radius, d.spatial_type, (select count(*)::int from simulation_features) as total_point_count, (select count(*)::int from simulation_features) as total_feature_count, count(r.feature_id)::int as matched_point_count, count(r.feature_id)::int as matched_feature_count, count(r.feature_id)::int as hotspot_count, coalesce(round(avg(r.distance_meters)::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision as average_distance_meters, coalesce(round(min(r.distance_meters)::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision as nearest_distance_meters, coalesce(round(avg(r.distance_meters)::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision as average_nearby_count, coalesce(round(max(r.distance_meters))::int, 0) as max_nearby_count from sd_gis_dataset d where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} group by d.title, d.spatial_type

select r.rank, r.feature_id, coalesce(r.feature_name, concat('Feature ', r.feature_id)) as feature_name, r.geometry_type, 0 as nearby_count, round(ST_Y(r.center_geom_4326)::numeric, 6)::double precision as latitude, round(ST_X(r.center_geom_4326)::numeric, 6)::double precision as longitude, r.distance_meters from ranked r order by r.rank limit #{limit}

, selected_results as ( select * from ranked order by rank limit #{limit} ) select jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', coalesce(jsonb_agg(feature order by rank), '[]'::jsonb) )::text from ( select r.rank, jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(r.geom_4326, 6)::jsonb, 'properties', jsonb_build_object( 'layerType', 'resultFeature', 'rank', r.rank, 'featureId', r.feature_id, 'geometryType', r.geometry_type, 'name', coalesce(r.feature_name, concat('Feature ', r.feature_id)), 'distanceMeters', r.distance_meters, 'radius', #{radius}, 'selectedLat', #{lat}, 'selectedLng', #{lng} ) ) as feature from selected_results r ) result_features
